name: io.github.lx1112/onchaincheck-web
title: OnchainCheck Web
description: Web search, page fetch as clean text, extraction, site audits, docs to Markdown. Pay per call (x402)

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web: up to 10 results for a query, most relevant first, each with title, URL, publish date, author and the passage of the page that best matches the query. Optional filters: category (news, company, publication, people...), domains to include or exclude, and since (YYYY-MM-DD) for recent pages only. Pair with /web/contents to read the pages. Costs $0.006 USDC on Base via x402.

category.description: Limit to one kind of page

since.description: Only pages published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

snippets.description: false leaves out the matching passages (default true)

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL and get the response as sent: HTTP status, content type, key headers, the redirect chain, timing and the raw body (HTML, JSON, XML or text, up to 500 KB). For agents that parse pages or call public JSON endpoints themselves; use /web/extract for clean Markdown. Public http(s) URLs only. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: web_contents
tools.description: Read up to 5 web pages in one call as clean text for an LLM, in the Exa /contents shape: POST {urls: [...], text: {maxCharacters}} and get results with url, title, author, publishedDate, image and the main text as Markdown (navigation, header, footer and scripts dropped), plus a per-URL status. One flat price per call. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: web_extract
tools.description: Read a web page as clean Markdown for an LLM: fetches the URL, drops navigation, header, footer, forms and scripts, and returns the main text as Markdown with title, description, language, author, publish date, image and word count. Optional links=true adds the page's links. Text and JSON URLs come back as-is. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

links.description: true adds the page's links (up to 300)

tools.name: web_check
tools.description: Is this URL up and set up right? For 1-5 URLs: up or down and why (DNS or connect error, timeout, TLS failure, 5xx), status, response time, redirect chain and final URL, whether http redirects to https, TLS verified, CDN and server, cache policy, and a security-header grade A-F with findings (HSTS, CSP, clickjacking, nosniff). URLs that answer 402 also get their x402 payment terms: networks, assets, amounts, payTo. Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

url.description: A public http(s) URL or domain

tools.name: website_audit
tools.description: Website audit in one call: HTTP security headers (HSTS, CSP, clickjacking, cookies, mixed content), on-page SEO (title, meta description, h1, canonical, noindex, robots.txt, sitemap, Open Graph, structured data), static WCAG 2.1 accessibility checks (alt text, labels, link and button names, lang, zoom), server response time and page weight, and the tech stack. Findings with severity and a 0-100 score per section. Repeat audits list what changed since the previous one. Costs $0.05 USDC on Base via x402.

url.description: Page URL or domain to audit (https://example.org/pricing)

tools.name: website_history
tools.description: A website's history from the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine: first and last capture, how many years and months it was archived, activity by year, the longest gap, the last capture's HTTP status and links to the first and last snapshots. Useful for domain age, due diligence and spotting parked or re-registered domains. Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: agent_access_check
tools.description: May an agent fetch and use this URL? robots.txt applied per RFC 9309 to your user agent and to 12 AI crawlers and fetchers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended...), crawl-delay, X-Robots-Tag and meta robots, noai and TDM reservation opt-outs, redirects and x402. Plus agent readiness, scored 0-100: llms.txt, MCP server card, A2A agent card, OpenAPI, sitemap. Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

url.description: Page URL or domain to check

agent.description: robots.txt product token to check for (default *)

tools.name: document_to_markdown
tools.description: Convert a document at a URL to Markdown for an LLM: PDF, Word (DOCX), Excel (XLSX, XLS), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS), CSV and XML, up to 20 MB. Returns the Markdown with character, word and token counts. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: extract_tables
tools.description: Extract the tables from a document as typed JSON: send text (CSV, TSV, semicolon or pipe separated, Markdown tables or HTML), html, or a url to a web page or CSV file. Each table gets headers (multi-row headers joined, colspan and rowspan expanded), column types (number, percent, currency, date, boolean, string) and rows with parsed values. Deterministic, no model; up to 20 tables and 500 rows each. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

text.description: CSV, TSV, Markdown or HTML text containing tables

url.description: A public web page or CSV file, instead of text

tools.name: wiki_lookup
tools.description: What something is, in one call: the best-matching Wikipedia article for a topic, name or title (any language) with description, summary, link, thumbnail and coordinates; key Wikidata facts (type, country, founded or born, headquarters, founders, CEO, employees, ticker, website, population...); and its daily pageviews with a trend, as a measure of attention. Text CC BY-SA, facts CC0. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

q.description: Topic, name or article title (Anthropic, Lisbon, Ada Lovelace)

tools.name: wikipedia_trending
tools.description: What people are reading on Wikipedia: a day's most-viewed articles in any language edition, with views, change against the day before (or new entry), desktop and mobile shares, short description, thumbnail and link. Pages whose traffic looks automated are flagged and left out; the main page and non-article pages are skipped. Sort by views or by views gained. Latest day by default, or any day since July 2015. Data: Wikimedia Pageviews (CC0). Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

date.description: UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: the latest published day)

sort.description: views (default) or rising (views gained on the day before)

include_automated.description: Keep pages whose traffic looks automated (default false)

tools.name: example_output
tools.description: Free. Shows what a paid tool on this server returns: its price, an example input and the output captured from a real paid call. Tools: web_search, web_fetch, web_contents, web_extract, web_check, website_audit, website_history, agent_access_check, document_to_markdown, extract_tables, wiki_lookup, wikipedia_trending.

tool.description: Name of a paid tool on this server
